item.title: Abp Lori issues pastoral letter on renewal of U.S. political culture
item.description: Drawing on the writings of Popes Leo XIV, Francis, and Benedict XVI, the pastoral letter offers an unsparing view of the state of U.S. political discourse.

item.title: Senior U.S. Church leaders call for presidential apology in wake of racist social media post
item.description: Cardinal Blase Cupich Archbishop Edward Weisenburger called on Trump to apologize for sharing a racist video meme to his Truth Social account, calling the harm done by his action real and saying his explanations for his behavior are inadequate.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV warns Madrid’s priests that faith can be instrumentalized or relegated amid political uncertainty
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has sent a letter to approximately 1,100 priests from Madrid, warning them that growing polarization and secularization puts the faith at dual risk of being instrumentalized or made irrelevant.

item.title: Pope Leo uses Winter Olympics to define Church’s relationship with sport
item.description: As the world’s attention turns to Italy for the Winter Olympics, Pope Leo XIV took the opportunity to send a letter marking the occasion. He used it to talk about the Church's attitude to all sports.

item.title: Priest arrested during pensioners protest in Argentina
item.description: Spanish-born Father Francisco Olvera, known in Argentina as Padre Paco, was arrested during a pensioners’ protest in front of the Argentine Congress in Buenos Aires on Feb. 4.

item.title: Catholic cross like no other is a beacon of unity in Olympic host city Milan
item.description: Much like the Olympic flame, there is another symbol of triumph and transcendence — far less known — that graces one host city after another: a one-of-a-kind, wooden cross.

item.title: Peruvian prelate pioneering prison reform calls for social development
item.description: One Peruvian bishop who was recently in Rome for official meetings with Pope Leo and Vatican departments is determined to carry forward the pope’s push for social action, specifically through prison reform.

item.title: Emerging artists making rap, Afrobeats and R&B music push Christian genre boundaries
item.description: A new wave of artists is transcending traditional notions of Christian music, drawing young global audiences to faith-based rap, Afrobeats and R&B.

item.title: Bulgarians pray for bees and bless honey on St. Haralambos Day
item.description: Illuminated by the flickering glow of candlelight, priests approached the tables arranged in the shape of a cross in the middle of a church, enveloped in the heady scent of incense wafting from a censer.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV: Audience appeals for Colombian flood victims, sick & suffering worldwide, European unity
item.description: In Spanish-language remarks to pilgrims and tourists present in the Paul VI Hall for his weekly General Audience on Wednesday morning, the pontiff said he commends “the victims and all those affected by the severe floods in Colombia.”
